checks.note: Broad healthy-rest scale, not a patient-specific arterial blood-gas reference interval.

checks.name: exercise capillary-transit scale and A-a widening
checks.note: Warren's PaO2=85 mmHg cohort were endurance athletes; v0.13 validates transit-time scale and A-a direction rather than forcing that exact PaO2.

checks.name: V/Q mismatch produces hypoxemia and wasted ventilation
true shunt and diffusion limitation are separable mechanisms
supplemental-O2 response distinguishes shunt from V/Q mismatch
checks.note: Relative responsiveness is tested; no treatment recommendation or clinical FiO2 target is inferred.

credibility_classification.VQ_distribution: six-compartment reduced forward model inspired by MIGET physiology; not a MIGET inversion
credibility_classification.true_shunt: explicit venous admixture by O2 content
credibility_classification.oxygen_diffusion: finite equilibration driven by capillary transit time and a reduced diffusion-capacity parameter
credibility_classification.dead_space: anatomical dead space plus reduced high-V/Q wasted-ventilation diagnostic; Enghoff-like rather than direct Bohr PACO2 measurement
credibility_classification.CO2: v0.12 conserved whole-blood carbon pool retained; regional CO2 exchange remains reduced

remaining_limitations: no dynamic alveolar recruitment/derecruitment or compliance distribution
no full regional CO2 content mixing per V/Q compartment
no explicit DLCO/DLNO membrane and capillary conductance decomposition
no aerosol/airway mechanics or disease-specific COPD/ARDS parameter estimation
next_high_value_step: v0.14 should add hypoxic pulmonary vasoconstriction and dynamic regional perfusion/recruitment, then validate V/Q distributions against a published MIGET dataset before introducing ARDS/COPD disease models.
